description: This header file declares utility functions and enums for metrics collection and reporting within the cuttlefish project, including functions for retrieving system info, generating session IDs, and posting metrics data.
external_methods: MetricsExitCodes PostRequest(const std::string& output, ClearcutServer server)

methods.name: GetOsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operating system.

methods.name: GetOsVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the operating system.

methods.name: GenerateSessionId
methods.description: Generates a session ID based on the provided timestamp.

methods.name: GetCfVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current version of the software (Cuttlefish).

methods.name: GetMacAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the system.

methods.name: GetCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the environment or device.

methods.name: GetVmmVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the virtual machine monitor.

methods.name: GetEpochTimeMs
methods.description: Returns the current epoch time in milliseconds.

methods.name: ProtoToString
methods.description: Converts a LogEvent protobuf message to its string representation.

methods.name: PostRequest
methods.description: Posts a metrics report to the specified Clearcut server (local, staging, production).

calls: MetricsExitCodes PostRequest(const std::string& output, ClearcutServer server)
